notes: Compass Fostering's own 'Fostering in Norwich' page, located in its Compass Fostering East region: says there is an urgent need for more foster carers in Norwich and that its local office helps people interested in fostering in Norwich.

Nexus Fostering's own Norwich (Anglia regional) office page: actively recruiting foster carers in Norfolk and Suffolk, including Norwich, Great Yarmouth, Swaffham, Thetford, Stowmarket, Ipswich and Lowestoft. Added to the Nexus entry that already lists East Anglia.

Capstone Foster Care's own 'Foster in Slough' page: recruiting foster carers, working in partnership with Slough Borough Council and serving local areas of Slough (Burnham, Chalvey, Cippenham, Langley, Upton and others); links to its South East local office, the Capstone entry that lists South East.

Orange Grove Foster Care's own Bracknell Forest page (Southern Counties team): its Bracknell Forest training centre supports families across Berkshire including Slough, Maidenhead, Woodley and Reading, and it also supports families fostering in Wokingham and Windsor. Entry already lists Berkshire.
